eps.o: Sweetie the honey badger gets into a sticky situation when the bees think he's stolen honey from their hive. Can Sam and Kit catch the real robber?

eps.t: The Shadow of the Sky Pirates
eps.o: To get stolen clams back from a naughty crew of flying pirates, Kit and Sam convince their nature ranger pal Wally Bungler to wear a sneaky disguise.
When lost lemmings looking for a safe home crowd into a snowy town of arctic hares, Sam and Kit help the small explorers find a new place to live.

eps.t: The Riddle of the Lion's Roar
eps.o: Agent Cubby gets scared by a lion's roar and disappears during hoverboard training. To find her, Kit and Sam team up with Harry, a helpful hornbill.

eps.t: The Burrow of the Booty Bumper
eps.o: Sam and Kit try to track down a big furry creature in the grasslands after it frightens a family of dingoes away from their new burrow.
A scary wildfire separates an African wild dog from her pack. Kit and Sam need extra backup for this mission, so the whole CLADE team shows up to help.
When Kit accidentally brings a disappearing frog from the jungle into CLADE HQ, the agents hop to it to find the frog before the new Cleaner Bots do.

eps.t: The Island of the Lost Rabbits
eps.o: Dropped on a remote island without any gadgets to help them, Sam and Kit use the CLADE Wilderness Guide Book to save baby rabbits from a hungry snake.

eps.t: The Mystery of the Missing Acorns
eps.o: The agents try to discover who's stealing Wendy the woodpecker's acorns from her winter stash -- but there's more than one nut thief hiding in the trees.
The desert is hot -- and someone's stolen the water tank spigot. Kit and Sam question some slithery suspects to solve the mystery so no one goes thirsty.
